zh.title: 巴西 GOL 737 機隊明年推高階座位 國內線也適用
zh.summary: GOL Premium 將於2027年2月15日上路，前3排保留中間座位不售，每架提供12席。
body: 巴西 GOL 航空宣佈，2027年2月15日起，737-700、737-800 與 737 MAX 8 機隊將採用新的座位分類，涵蓋國內與國際航班。機票於2026年12月15日開賣。
GOL Premium 位於前3排，每架提供12席，中間座位保留不售。新產品將取代國際線現有的豪華經濟艙，也是 GOL 首次在國內線提供這項高階服務。

en.title: Brazil’s GOL airline to add premium seating across its Boeing 737 fleet
en.summary: GOL Premium launches on February 15, 2027, with 12 seats in the first three rows and the middle seats blocked.
body: GOL said its Boeing 737-700, 737-800 and 737 MAX 8 fleet will adopt a new seating structure from February 15, 2027. It applies to domestic and international flights, with sales opening on December 15, 2026.

GOL Premium will occupy the first three rows, offering 12 seats per aircraft by blocking the middle seats. It replaces the existing international premium economy product and brings the new product to domestic flights.

facts.claim: GOL Premium launches on February 15, 2027, with 12 seats in the first three rows and the middle seats blocked.
